query: query adjournConveneValues($sessionAbbreviation: String, $where: LegislativeDayWhere! = {}, $historic: Boolean!) { calendarDates: legislativeDayValues(field: "calendarDate", where: [{ sessionAbbreviation: { eq: $sessionAbbreviation } }, $where], order: ["calendarDate", "DESC"]) sessionAbbreviations: legislativeDayValues(field: "sessionAbbreviation", where: [{ sessionAbbreviation: { eq: $sessionAbbreviation } }, $where], order: ["sessionAbbreviation", "DESC"]) @include(if: $historic) legislativeDays: legislativeDayValues(field: "legislativeDay", where: [{ sessionAbbreviation: { eq: $sessionAbbreviation } }, $where]) }
